title: CFE busca mil millones de dólares entre inversionistas: ¿A qué destinará ese dinero?
summary: La CFE busca recaudar unos mil millones de dólares el próximo mes mediante un vehículo de inversión para financiar nuevas líneas de transmisión, mientras Sheinbaum intenta atraer capital privado al sector.

title: US Midterm Candidates Tap Rare Bipartisan Issue: Credit Card Rates
summary: With control of Congress hinging on razor-thin races, both parties are tapping voter frustration over rising credit card debt and rates as a rare bipartisan campaign issue.

title: Investors trim growth bets over fears of US economy’s AI exposure
summary: Investors are returning to bonds after a long sell-off and trimming growth bets as concern rises about the US economy's over-reliance on tech and AI spending.

title: Inseguridad en México cambia cómo se paga y se compra en línea: 27% ya usa tarjetas digitales
summary: El estudio Consumer Pulse 2026 de Bain & Company muestra que la inseguridad en México está cambiando la forma de pagar y comprar en línea: 27% ya usa tarjetas digitales. La desconfianza transforma los hábitos de pago y el comercio electrónico.

title: AI Enthusiasm Is Collapsing and Tech Earnings Just Made It Worse
summary: Tras los reportes de las grandes tecnológicas, el mercado esperaba claridad pero las dudas sobre el enorme gasto en inteligencia artificial persisten y los resultados las agravaron. Bloomberg analiza cómo se debilita el entusiasmo por la IA.

title: SoftBank-Backed OPay Halts IPO to Respond to Regulatory Inquiry
summary: Nigeria-focused payments platform OPay halted its planned NYSE IPO, which was due to start trading Friday, citing a regulatory inquiry. The episode follows a $304 million US raise.

title: OpenAI’s Altman Meets Samsung Executives as Chip Crunch Deepens
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman met top Samsung executives in South Korea to deepen cooperation on memory chips and AI infrastructure as global shortages intensify.

title: Is this the first clear evidence of AI’s impact on the labour market?
summary: The FT asks whether new data offers the first clear evidence of AI's effect on jobs: productivity is rising and employment falling in the tech sector, while the picture elsewhere is muddier.

title: OpenAI Funding Target Cut by $10 Billion as AI Slumps, FT Says
summary: OpenAI has cut its fundraising target by $10 billion, according to the Financial Times, as an AI stock selloff and Anthropic's upcoming public listing complicate its efforts to secure investor commitments. The move signals tightening appetite for AI mega-rounds.

title: Crypto Hack Reignites Regulatory Debate
summary: A $6 billion crypto hack has put digital-asset security back in the spotlight. Former CFTC chair J. Christopher Giancarlo argues it exposed weaknesses at one firm rather than a failure of blockchain itself.

title: Baseten to Raise Funding That Would Double Value to $30 Billion
summary: AI startup Baseten is set to raise funding that would more than double its valuation to about $30 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Meta’s Rating Outlook Cut to Negative by S&P on AI Spending
summary: S&P Global Ratings took an early step toward a possible downgrade of Meta's credit rating within two years, citing balance-sheet pressure from elevated AI-related spending.

title: Hacienda descarta volver a utilizar P-Caps para apoyar finanzas de Pemex
summary: El secretario de Hacienda, Édgar Amador, dijo que no prevén volver a usar las Notas Precapitalizadas (P-Caps) para apoyar las finanzas de Pemex.

title: GAFI acepta reporte de la evaluación antilavado de México, publicará resultados en diciembre
summary: El GAFI adoptó los reportes de la evaluación mutua de México y Estados Unidos en su plenaria en París. Los resultados completos, incluido el desempeño antilavado de México, se publicarán en diciembre.

title: Binance admite robo de fondos en la hot wallet por ciberataque; anuncia plan para recuperar el dinero
summary: Binance admitió el robo de fondos de su hot wallet por un ciberataque y anunció un plan para recuperar el dinero.

title: Big Tech Holds $3 Trillion in Spending Commitments for AI Boom
summary: The five largest data-center players have committed more than $3 trillion in spending over the coming years, underscoring the scale of ongoing investment in AI infrastructure.

title: El peso se debilita otra vez: el precio de dólar roza los MXN$19
summary: El dólar se acerca a los MXN$19 ante la incertidumbre sobre el diferencial de tasas entre México y otras economías. El peso cotizó en 18.92 por dólar, con una depreciación diaria.

title: AI Policy Risks Loom Over Stock, Bond Traders Ahead of Midterms
summary: Wall Street espera que los demócratas ganen al menos una cámara en las elecciones de medio término, lo que podría traer volatilidad en acciones y bonos, con la supervisión de la IA entre los temas de riesgo.

title: Google’s $500bn bloodbath reflects the danger it faces from AI
summary: The Economist examines Google's $500bn market-value drop, arguing it reflects the threat AI poses to its core search business as its search engine sputters and rivals gain ground.
